metadata.title: Robot SF 14-planner S30 authored-budget benchmark dataset
metadata.description: Benchmark-data snapshot for Robot SF covering 14 planner arms, 48 social-navigation scenarios, and 30 seeds with independently pinned authored horizons (400/500/600/650/700), dt=0.1 and differential-drive kinematics (20,160 expected episode identities). The archive preserves raw episode and component-metric evidence with exact source provenance: source commit {{source_sha}}, source first parent {{latest_main_base_commit}}, release tag {{release_tag}}, concept DOI {{concept_doi}}, and version DOI {{version_doi}}. SNQI v2 scores are computed with anchors calibrated on development seeds 1001/1002, disjoint from the 30 sealed evaluation seeds, and are reported as advisory only; this release makes no SNQI ranking claim.
